_comment: Perf-smoke gate POLICY. Thresholds live here, in git, so changing what fails a PR is reviewable and has history. Measured reference values (median, spread, sample count) live in the baseline store instead, because those are measurements and should not require a PR to update. Keys are gpu_model (canonical slug) -> task_id -> backend_key, where backend_key is '{physics}' or '{physics}_{render}'. hard_floor_fps is a catastrophic-failure detector, NOT a regression threshold: it should sit far below any plausible healthy value so it only fires when a run is fundamentally broken. Regression percentages are compared against the baseline median.

defaults._todo: Both defaults are placeholders. Set them from measured run-to-run spread on the real L40S runners, not from the desktop RTX 5090 sweep in temp/matrix_run (that host showed 13% CV on Cartpole, which is likely runner-specific).

per_task_regression_pct._comment: Overrides for tasks whose run-to-run noise makes the default threshold unusable. A threshold below the noise floor fires on noise; a threshold far above it never fires at all.

Isaac-Cartpole-Direct._todo: Measured 12.99% (physx) / 11.26% (newton) run-to-run CV on RTX 5090. At that noise a 3% block threshold needs n>29 samples to resolve. Either widen these, keep Cartpole advisory-only, or re-measure on L40S and set from that. Do NOT leave it at the default.
newton floor is 0.0 (disabled). RTX 5090 sweep measured ~887,748 fps mean. Pick a floor ~an order of magnitude below the L40S healthy value so it catches a broken run without tracking performance.

Isaac-Reorient-Cube-Shadow-Camera-Benchm._todo: Three of four floors are 0.0 (disabled). RTX 5090 sweep measured physx_newton_renderer ~22,556 and newton_newton_renderer ~30,579 fps; both *_rtx_renderer combos failed on that host with cudaErrorIllegalAddress and need re-measuring (physx_rtx_renderer does succeed in CI on L40S).

Isaac-Velocity-Flat-G1._todo: newton floor is 0.0 (disabled). RTX 5090 sweep measured ~26,936 fps mean.
